follow-up time: Through delivery and early neonatal period
cohort: 105 pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and their 107 newborns, from the GESNEO-COVD cohort in Spain
finding: Although vertical transmission was not definitively proven in this cohort, COVID-19 pneumonia during pregnancy increased the risk of caesarean section deliveries and preterm births.
mod_finding: COVID-19 pneumonia during pregnancy increased the risk of cesarean section deliveries (OR: 4.203, CI 95%: 1.473-11.995).
